objective: Provide a document that gives a seperate punet square diagram for each one of every possible combination of Pokemon. Assume every Pokemon is genetically compatible with every other Pokemon and that every evolution is a genetically distinct Pokemon. Use the first two letters of a Pokemon's name as its genetic code (ex: PI for Pikachu) and if multiple Pokemon share the same first two initials, distingish the duplicates by adding an exponent to each letter (ex:  P^2I^2 for Piplup) and increase the exponent by one for each additional Pokemon that needs to be distinguished this way, within the same letter paring.
